EVID_06.title: Organoid modeling of human fetal lung alveolar development reveals mechanisms of cell fate patterning
EVID_06.verbatim_quote: UMAP plots showing transcript expression of AT2 lineage markers, SFTPC, HOPX, SLC34A2, and tip progenitor marker, SOX9, in the organoids. Text affirms AT2-specific HOPX, LAMP3, and ACE2 proteins increased during differentiation.
EVID_06.visual_observation: Figure 3D UMAP demonstrates distinct co-localization of HOPX, SFTPC, and SLC34A2 transcripts within the AT2 differentiated organoid cluster, confirming HOPX as an AT2 lineage marker in human fetal lung development.
EVID_06.relevance: Core correction confirming HOPX as AT2 lineage marker, along with LAMP3, SLC34A2, SFTPC, ACE2.

EVID_07.title: Organoid modeling of human fetal lung alveolar development reveals mechanisms of cell fate patterning
EVID_07.verbatim_quote: (D) Tip epithelium (arrowheads) is marked by E-cadherin, SFTPC, HTII-280, and SOX9. SOX2, airway epithelium (C). (E) The early-stage tip epithelium at 10 pcw expresses SOX9 and TPPP3, and gains the expression of the alveolar lineage marker, SFTPC, at late stages, 15 and 19 pcw. The SFTPC+ stalk cells (hereafter, fetal AT2 cells) at 15 and 19 pcw lack SOX9 and TPPP3 expression (SOX9-TPPP3-SFTPC+). (F) Arrowheads indicate CD36+PDPN- tips.
EVID_07.visual_observation: Figure S1D-F immunofluorescence clearly distinguishes distal tip epithelium (SOX9+, SFTPC+, CD36+, PDPN-) from proximal airway epithelium (SOX2+) and stalk cells.
EVID_07.relevance: Validates SOX9, TPPP3, SFTPC, CD36 in tip epithelium, SOX2 in airway epithelium, and negative gating of PDPN in tips.

EVID_08.title: Organoid modeling of human fetal lung alveolar development reveals mechanisms of cell fate patterning
EVID_08.locator: Figure S5E, S5M, S5N, S5O, S5P & legend (p. 40-41)
EVID_08.verbatim_quote: (E) WNT2, alveolar fibroblasts, white; NOTUM, myofibroblasts, red; CD44, tip epithelium, green. (M) Summary diagram showing the spatial regulation of Wnt signalling mediated by ACTA2+PDGFRa+CD141+ myofibroblasts. (N) Time course analysis of NOTUM+ myofibroblasts, SCGB3A2+ terminal airway cells, and SFTPC+ tip and stalk. (O and P) Time-course visualization (O) and quantitation (P) of SFTPC-/SPOCK2+ stalk cells (hereafter, fetal AT1 cells) and SFTPC+/SPOCK2- stalk cells (fetal AT2 cells)... SPOCK2, red, AT1 cell marker; SFTPC, green, AT2 cell marker; white, NKX2.1, lung epithelial cell marker.
EVID_08.visual_observation: Figure S5 panels show spatial localization of NOTUM+/ACTA2+/PDGFRA+/CD141+ myofibroblasts and WNT2+ alveolar fibroblasts. Stalk regions contain distinct SPOCK2+ (AT1) and SFTPC+ (AT2) subpopulations.
EVID_08.relevance: Validates myofibroblast markers (NOTUM, ACTA2, PDGFRA, THBD), alveolar fibroblast marker (WNT2), AT1 marker (SPOCK2), and terminal airway (SCGB3A2).

EVID_09.title: A human fetal lung cell atlas uncovers proximal-distal gradients of differentiation and key regulators
EVID_09.verbatim_quote: We detected ciliated cells (FOXJ1+, ALOX15+) from 11 pcw, interspersed with secretory/club cells (Figures 2A–2C, S3H, S4A, and S4B). Rarer deuterosomal cells (FOXJ1+, CDC20B+) appeared at the same time. MUC16+ ciliated cells (FOXJ1+, DNAH+, MUC16LO) were also detected... Tip cells express a core set of tip-specific markers (SOX9+, ETV5+, TESC+, TPPP3+, and STC1+).
EVID_09.visual_observation: Figure 2C dot plot illustrates gene expression across epithelial lineages: FOXJ1 and ALOX15 in ciliated cells; CDC20B in deuterosomal cells; SOX9 and ETV5 in tip cells; MUC16, SCGB1A1, SCGB3A1, SCGB3A2 in distinct secretory subsets.
EVID_09.relevance: Validates ciliated, deuterosomal, tip, and secretory lineage markers.

EVID_10.title: A human fetal lung cell atlas uncovers proximal-distal gradients of differentiation and key regulators
EVID_10.verbatim_quote: The broad fibroblast cluster comprises fibroblasts, myofibroblasts, airway and vascular smooth muscle (ASM and vSMC), pericytes, mesothelium, and chondrocytes (Figures 4A and 4B). Airway fibroblasts and chondrocytes were proximally enriched and mesothelium distally enriched... Isolated PDGFRA+CD141+ myofibroblasts express high levels of ACTA2, NOTUM, and LEF1. Whereas PDGFRA-CD141- fibroblasts express high levels of WNT2 and FGFR4.
EVID_10.visual_observation: Figure 4B dot plot displays distinct expression signatures for mesenchymal subsets: ASPN, COL2A1 in chondrocytes; ACTA2, TAGLN in ASM; PLN, NTN4 in vSMC; WNT2 in alveolar fibroblasts; WNT2B, FGF10 in airway fibroblasts.
EVID_10.relevance: Primary validation for mesenchymal subsets (myofibroblast, ASM, vSMC, pericyte, chondrocyte, adventitial/alveolar/airway fibroblasts).

EVID_11.title: A human fetal lung cell atlas uncovers proximal-distal gradients of differentiation and key regulators
EVID_11.verbatim_quote: ASCL1 and NEUROD1 regulate the formation of two subtypes of neuroendocrine cells. Classical pulmonary NE cells (GRP+) and GHRL+ NE cells (TTR+, GHRL+)... NEUROD1 was co-expressed with GHRL but also observed with GRP, whereas NEUROG3 was co-expressed with ASCL1 and/or NEUROD1, supporting a role in a transition population.
EVID_11.visual_observation: Figure 7A-E clearly delineates the bifurcated trajectory of NE cells: ASCL1/GRP in classical PNEC vs NEUROD1/GHRL/TTR/RFX6 in GHRL+ NE, with NEUROG3 marking intermediate progenitors.
EVID_11.relevance: Core evidence resolving PNEC vs GHRL+ NE vs intermediate NE cell granularity and TF markers.

EVID_12.title: A human fetal lung cell atlas uncovers proximal-distal gradients of differentiation and key regulators
EVID_12.verbatim_quote: At 5–6 pcw, the endothelial cells (ECs) comprised capillary (early Cap: THY1+, CD24+), GRIA2+ arterial (GRIA2+, GJA5+), and lymphatic ECs (PROX1+, STAB1+, and UCP2LO)... Aerocytes express CA4 and S100A3... PLN is expressed in ASM but absent from vSMC.
EVID_12.visual_observation: Figure S7B dot plot shows endothelial marker breakdown (CA4, S100A3, EDNRB in aerocytes; GJA5, EFNB2 in arterial EC; ACKR3, NR2F2 in venous EC; PROX1, STAB1 in lymphatic EC). Figure S7F-H shows vSMC (NDUFA4L2+, PLN-) vs adventitial fibroblast (NTRK3+, NDUFA4L2-).
EVID_12.relevance: Validates endothelial specialization subsets and vSMC/fibroblast distinction.

EVID_13.title: A human fetal lung cell atlas uncovers proximal-distal gradients of differentiation and key regulators
EVID_13.verbatim_quote: (C) Expression of NEUROD1, GHRL, and GRP in PNEC vs GHRL+ NE cells. (D) Co-expression analysis of NEUROG3 with ASCL1 and NEUROD1. (E) HCR staining for RFX6 in GHRL+ NE cells.
EVID_13.visual_observation: Figure S8C-E shows mutually exclusive or enriched expression patterns confirming GHRL and NEUROD1 are positive in GHRL+ NE and negative in classic PNEC, whereas GRP is positive in classic PNEC and negative in GHRL+ NE.
EVID_13.relevance: Supports polarity and specificity of NE subtype transcription factors and peptide hormones.

EVID_14.title: A human fetal lung cell atlas uncovers proximal-distal gradients of differentiation and key regulators
EVID_14.verbatim_quote: Extraneous contaminant clusters (APOA1+ APOA2+ liver/yolk sac, ACTN2+ MYH6+ cardiomyocytes, GSTA3+ PAGE4+ cytotrophoblasts, SOX2+ TP63+ KRT5+ esophagus epithelial cells) were identified and removed during preprocessing.
EVID_14.visual_observation: Text clearly documents exclusion of anatomical contaminants that are not intrinsic lung cell types.
EVID_14.relevance: Authoritative basis for hard exclusion of contaminant markers (M00164, M00165, M00171, M00172, M00185, M00186, M00194, M00195, M00196).
